# Figma Research Report

## Company Overview

- Figma, Inc. develops and sells a collaborative, browser-based platform for designing, prototyping, building digital experiences, and subscriptions for access to its platform. [8]
- Figma Design was launched in 2015 using WebGL technology to bring design into the browser for the first time. [9]
- FigJam, an online whiteboarding tool, was launched in 2021. [9]
- Dev Mode, a product tailored for developers, was launched in 2023. [9]
- Figma Slides was introduced in 2024. [9]
- Figma was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California. [8]
- Figma completed its IPO in July 2025. [11]
- Figma has 1,886 employees. [11]
- Figma's stock symbol is FIG. [11]

## Industry Overview

- Figma operates in the Collaborative Design And Prototyping category. [2]
- Figma's top competitors in the Collaborative Design And Prototyping category include Adobe Discover (18.96% market share), Adobe Premiere Pro CC (16.33%), and Adobe XD (9.33%). [2]
- Figma is a collaborative interface design tool. [2]
- Figma's primary competition in UI/UX design and prototyping included Sketch, InVision, and Adobe XD. [3]
- Figma competes with Adobe, Canva, Framer, Lucidspark, Miro, Mural, Penpot, Sketch, UxPin, Axure, and InVision. [5]

## Financial Overview

- Figma's revenue for the third quarter of 2025 was $274.2 million, an increase of 38% year-over-year. [1]
- Figma's GAAP loss from operations for the third quarter of 2025 was $(1.1) billion, with a GAAP operating margin of (415)%. [1]
- Figma's GAAP net loss for the third quarter of 2025 was $(1.1) billion, while its non-GAAP net income was $62.4 million. [1]
- Figma's Net Dollar Retention Rate for customers with ARR of $10,000 or more was 131% as of September 30, 2025. [1]
- Figma raised $200 million at a $10 billion valuation. [10]

## News

- Figma announced a partnership with Anthropic on February 17, 2026, to launch a feature called "Code to Canvas" that converts code generated by AI tools like Claude Code into editable designs inside Figma. [6]
- Figma works with OpenAI through a ChatGPT and FigJam integration. [4]
- Figma has struck partnerships with Anthropic and OpenAI to integrate AI CLI tools like Claude Code and Codex into its design software. [7]
- Figma launched its own AI assistant within its collaborative canvas that responds to natural language prompts to generate or edit designs and automate tasks. [7]

# Airbnb Research Report

## Company Overview

- Airbnb, Inc. operates a global platform for stays and experiences. [7]
- Airbnb Inc operates a global marketplace that connects guests with hosts offering stays, experiences, and services. [9]
- Airbnb's main activities include facilitating short-term lodging and unique travel experiences through its online platform. [9]
- Airbnb is headquartered in San Francisco, CA, United States. [11]
- Airbnb was founded in 2007. [11]
- Airbnb has a presence in over 220 countries and regions worldwide. [11]
- Airbnb's major services encompass accommodations, curated experiences, and various travel-related services. [9]
- Airbnb utilizes a digital platform to connect users, providing tools for hosts to manage listings and for guests to book accommodations and experiences. [9]

## Industry Overview

- Airbnb operates in the short-term rental industry and competes with platforms including Booking.com, Vrbo, Expedia Group, HomesToGo/Tripping.com, Furnished Finder, Plum Guide, HipCamp, and Agoda. [1]
- Airbnb, Booking.com, and HomeAway are leading players in the paid peer-to-peer accommodation market, with Airbnb having seven million listings, Booking.com five million, and HomeAway two million. [2]
- Airbnb holds 44% of the short-term rental market share as of 2026, while Booking.com holds ~18% and Vrbo holds ~9%, according to Skift’s 2026 short-term rental report. [3]
- The short-term rental industry includes both traditional accommodation providers (e.g., Marriott, Accor) and peer-to-peer platforms (e.g., Airbnb, Couchsurfing), with an emerging 'new market' where they intersect — exemplified by Marriott Home & Villas, Accor onefinestay, and Airbnb Urbandoor. [2]

## Financial Overview

- Airbnb reported revenue of $859 million for the fourth quarter of 2020, representing a 22% year-over-year decline. [4]
- Airbnb lost $3.9 billion in the fourth quarter of 2020. [4]
- Airbnb's gross booking value was $5.9 billion in the fourth quarter of 2020, down 31% year-over-year. [4]
- Airbnb's revenue fell 67% in the quarter ending June 30, 2020. [4]
- Airbnb's total revenue is $11,943,000,064. [5]
- Airbnb's EBITDA is $2,760,999,936. [5]
- Airbnb's total debt is $2,278,000,128. [5]
- Airbnb's net income to common is $2,631,000,064. [5]
- Airbnb's price to book is 1.46. [5]
- Airbnb's enterprise to revenue is 0.39. [5]
- Airbnb's enterprise to EBITDA is 1.67. [5]

## News

- Airbnb and American Express launched an exclusive partnership, bringing over one million Airbnb listings to Amex Travel. [6]
- Airbnb.org announced partnerships with Fisher House Foundation and Operation Healing Forces to provide free stays for service members, veterans, and their families traveling for medical treatment. [8]
- Airbnb partnered with Tripadvisor to bring a selection of Tripadvisor experiences to the Airbnb platform, with certain tours, activities, and attractions available to book on Airbnb later in 2026. [10]
